newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo ends weaker but off earlier lows.
newsitem.headline: Escudo ends weaker but off earlier lows.

text.p: The escudo ended weaker against the mark with thin liquidity and stop-loss selling exacerbating its losses.
The escudo closed at 100.54/59 per mark after opening at 100.43/46 but was off morning lows of around 100.75. Stop-loss selling had emerged at 100.50 per mark.
Dealers said the Bank of Portugal stepped in this morning to buy escudos at around 100.70 per mark.

"On the strength of today's showing the escudo could lose more ground against the mark," said one dealer. But others thought the escudo's fundamentals would prop it up next week. -- Lisbon editorial +(351-1) 3538254
